findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "answer_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Adds the user's answers to a request that send_request returned with status needs_info, by its public_ref. The request was held because the business asks questi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business, send_request, request_match, get_request_status · Private data: get_business, send_request, request_match, get_request_status · Public sink: send_request, request_match, get_request_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business, send_request, request_match, get_request_status · Private data: get_business, send_request, request_match, get_request_status · Public sink: send_request, request_match, get_request_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
